outputAnomalyFlag.title: outputAnomalyFlag
outputAnomalyFlag.description: Indicates whether the warranty claim exhibits anomalous, suspicious ,or high-risk patterns based on historical claims, fleet behavior, dealer performance, and engineering signals.

outputClaimName.title: outputClaimName
outputClaimName.description: Normalized warranty claim reference used by the system (e.g. 0847), regardless of how the user originally provided the claim identifier.

outputClaimStatus.title: outputClaimStatus
outputClaimStatus.description: Current lifecycle status of the warranty claim, such as Submitted, In Review, Approved, Rejected, or Closed

outputClaimedAmount.title: outputClaimedAmount
outputClaimedAmount.description: Total monetary amount requested as part of the warranty claim.

outputDealerApprovalRate.title: outputDealerApprovalRate
outputDealerApprovalRate.description: Historical percentage of warranty claims approved for the associated dealer, used to assess dealer reliability.

outputDealerName.title: outputDealerName
outputDealerName.description: Name of the dealer or service center that submitted the warranty claim.

outputDealerTrustScore.title: outputDealerTrustScore
outputDealerTrustScore.description: Calculated trust score for the dealer based on historical approval rates, compliance, and claim quality metrics.

outputEngineeringCaseId.title: outputEngineeringCaseId
outputEngineeringCaseId.description: Internal system identifier for the related engineering investigation or analysis case associated with this warranty claim.

outputEngineeringCaseName.title: outputEngineeringCaseName
outputEngineeringCaseName.description: Human-readable reference or title of the engineering case linked to this warranty claim.

outputFailureDescription.title: outputFailureDescription
outputFailureDescription.description: Summary of the reported failure or issue that triggered the warranty claim.

outputFleetCount30Days.title: outputFleetCount30Days
outputFleetCount30Days.description: Number of similar warranty failures reported across the vehicle fleet within the last 30 days.

outputPartDescription.title: outputPartDescription
outputPartDescription.description: Description of the vehicle component or part associated with the reported warranty issue.

outputPartNumber.title: outputPartNumber
outputPartNumber.description: Manufacturer or system part number related to the failed component.

outputPriorClaimAmount.title: outputPriorClaimAmount
outputPriorClaimAmount.description: Claimed amount associated with the most recent prior related warranty claim, if one exists

outputPriorClaimDate.title: outputPriorClaimDate
outputPriorClaimDate.description: Submission date of the most recent prior related warranty claim.

outputPriorClaimFound.title: outputPriorClaimFound
outputPriorClaimFound.description: Indicates whether a previous related warranty claim was identified for the same vehicle, part, or failure type.

outputPriorClaimName.title: outputPriorClaimName
outputPriorClaimName.description: Reference number of the most recent prior related warranty claim, if found.

outputRecommendation.title: outputRecommendation
outputRecommendation.description: System-generated recommendation for handling the claim, such as Approve, Review Manually, Escalate, or Reject.

outputRiskScore.title: outputRiskScore
outputRiskScore.description: Calculated risk score representing the likelihood of fraud, error, or abnormal behavior for this claim.

outputTriageCategory.title: outputTriageCategory
outputTriageCategory.description: Assigned triage category indicating the urgency or handling path for the warranty claim.

outputVehicleMileage.title: outputVehicleMileage
outputVehicleMileage.description: Recorded odometer reading or mileage of the vehicle at the time the warranty claim was submitted.

outputVehicleModel.title: outputVehicleModel
outputVehicleModel.description: Model designation of the vehicle associated with the warranty claim.

outputVehicleName.title: outputVehicleName
outputVehicleName.description: Customer-facing name or variant of the vehicle associated with the warranty claim.

outputVehicleVIN.title: outputVehicleVIN
outputVehicleVIN.description: Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) associated with the warranty claim.

outputWarrantyExpiry.title: outputWarrantyExpiry
outputWarrantyExpiry.description: Warranty expiration date applicable to the vehicle at the time of claim evaluation.

outputWarrantyStatus.title: outputWarrantyStatus
outputWarrantyStatus.description: Indicates whether the vehicle warranty is Active, Expired, or Out of coverage at the time of the claim.
